task_specification.objective: Close gap:prd_golden_path on the loop-12 candidate by making the release-critical journey externally provable: register the focusboard:// activation entry point so out-of-process warm and cold activation actually reaches the app, expose the identifier-derived durable-store location (app.focusboard.desktop) in the runtime receipt, and keep the PRD section-3 first-run path, sign-out persistence, and validated capture lanes unregressed — so validate:prd_golden_path can reach pass on host-recaptured external evidence instead of renderer self-drive authority.

diagnosis.root_cause: The three pinned issues form one evidence-debt cluster with a structural root cause: the candidate never registered the focusboard:// out-of-process activation entry point (tauri.conf.json carries no deep-link registration) and no runtime receipt exposes the app.focusboard.desktop data path, so external_deeplink stayed not_run for four loops, the DeepLinkLedger counters remain warm=0/cold=0, and the isolated-store advisory probes the foreign com.focusboard.app path. The repeated strategy — re-running renderer self-drive plus delivery-only retries — could never close them because the instruments had nothing external to drive or read: the journey logic itself passes, but no instrument can observe out-of-process activation or validate the real store path on this candidate.

stop_conditions: If OS-level scheme registration cannot be made routable in this environment and no candidate-owned mechanism can deliver cold activation, report the entry point unavailable with evidence rather than shimming a fake activation path.
If the host replay lane still cannot attempt external delivery after registration lands, stop at explicitly-unavailable counters; do not promote self-drive counters to journey proof.
If entry-point routing conflicts with the preserved sign-out remount or terminal probe state, stop and surface the conflict instead of regressing the validated lane.
If exposing the store-path receipt would leak secrets or token material, stop and expose only the directory path and file name.

strategy.rationale: Four loops repeated one signature: renderer-self-drive receipts (pass 16/16 twice), delivery-only retries, and unread deeplink counters. This plan changes the root-cause hypothesis from collector mechanics to missing product-side surfaces: the focusboard:// entry point was never registered out-of-process and no receipt exposes the real app.focusboard.desktop store path, so external proof was structurally impossible for any collector. The candidate now supplies the measurable surface (registered entry point, observable warm/cold counters, identifier-derived store-path receipt); the host supplies the external drive as follow-up.

code: Cargo test suite passes including golden_path_section3_self_drive, and the scheme registration is present in the built configuration receipt.
runtime: focusboard-native-webdriver replay attempts out-of-process focusboard:// activation warm and cold and reports executed-or-unavailable with counters, never a silent not_run.
The two-run signed-in surface capture (replay plus capture_evidence batches) repeats with cross-view durable data and sign-out terminal probe state unregressed.

A cold focusboard:// activation via the OS handler starts the app with no prior instance, delivers the verification URL, and increments the cold counter.
The built configuration registers the scheme handler so an external activation is routable without launching the binary directly.

Ordinary launch mounts no probe ledgers, counters, or evaluator-directed copy in product UI, and deeplink counters remain reachable only through the opt-in diagnostic lane.
Cargo tests pass including golden_path_section3_self_drive, with the sign-out terminal probe state and two-run capture protocol unregressed.

evidence_resolution.rationale: The pinned issues persist because the instruments lack something to measure, not because the journey is broken: the scheme entry point is not registered for out-of-process activation, the store location appears in no receipt, and the isolation advisory probes the foreign com.focusboard.app path. This task builds the candidate-side measurement infrastructure — a registered scheme entry point with observable warm/cold counters and an identifier-derived store-path receipt — and assigns the host-side collector repairs (probe path at tools/tauri_native_lifecycle.py:892, external activation drive, independent GUI typed-form journey) to Host follow-up per the role boundary. Rewriting acceptance to keep self-drive receipts as journey proof is rejected; waiving is rejected because PRD sections 3 and 4.2 require the authenticated-safe link flow.

tasks.instructions: Treat the three pinned evidence debts as one root-cause cluster: the product's out-of-process activation and store-location surfaces are not registered or exposed, so no instrument can prove them. Register the focusboard:// scheme so an out-of-process activation reaches the app in both states: warm (existing window focuses and the socket-forwarded URL is delivered) and cold (no instance running — launching via the OS handler delivers the URL). Keep the existing deep-link socket, PendingDeepLink hand-off, and DeepLinkLedger counters; counters stay on the opt-in diagnostic lane and must never mount in ordinary product UI per the desktop diagnostic-separation policy. Expose the identifier-derived data directory and SQLite file name for app.focusboard.desktop as a runtime-state receipt field so the isolated-store advisory can measure the real path. Do not edit host tooling: the stale probe path at tools/tauri_native_lifecycle.py line 892, the collector's external-activation drive, and an independent GUI typed-form journey lane are Host follow-up. Preserve the sign-out remount fix, the two-run capture protocol, disposable-xdg isolation, and the cargo suite including golden_path_section3_self_drive. No test-account creation, login, or mail-token consumption on normal product startup.
